task.topic: Among patients hospitalized with heart failure, is higher liver stiffness or a validated liver-fibrosis score associated with subsequent adverse cardiac events?

pico.exposure: Liver stiffness or a validated liver-fibrosis score
pico.comparator: Source-defined higher versus lower exposure, or a one-unit exposure increase
outcomes: Composite cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalization/readmission

outcome.description: Composite cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalization/readmission

targets.effect_selection_rule: For each report, retain the adjudicated source-reported adjusted continuous hazard ratio for the source-defined liver-stiffness-related exposure. Preserve its exposure unit and adjustment set verbatim.

field_definitions.ci_lower: Lower 95% confidence bound reported by the source.
field_definitions.ci_upper: Upper 95% confidence bound reported by the source.
field_definitions.exposure_unit: Source-defined continuous increase, retained without rescaling.
field_definitions.adjustment_set: Covariates stated for the selected source model.

extraction_notes: Keep categorical exposure effects separate from the selected continuous effect.
